title: Organocatalyzed aza-Payne-type rearrangement of epoxy amines and carbon dioxide for efficient construction of oxazolidinones
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00192G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Xin Yuan, Jiahui Ma, Zhenjiang Li, Ziqi Liu, Yanqi Shi, Min Zhang, Yujia Wang, Xin Zou, Sha Li, Kai Guo
The ion pair organocatalyst is a new type of H-bonding bifunctional catalyst that promotes the construction of oxazolidinones under mild conditions through the aza-Payne-type rearrangement of epoxy amines with carbon dioxide.
